name: yf_stock_info
description:
Full Yahoo Finance profile and statistics for one ticker (yfinance Ticker.info).
Returns: {symbol, info} where info is Yahoo's flat dictionary (often 100+ keys) such as longName, sector, industry, currentPrice, marketCap, trailingPE, forwardPE, dividendYield, fiftyTwoWeekHigh, fiftyTwoWeekLow, targetMeanPrice, recommendationKey, longBusinessSummary; which keys appear depends on the security.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
For a few fields only use yf_fast_info; for ETFs yf_etf_info; for crypto yf_crypto_info. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
